asks: Which way is out? The way you came?
description: A stag stands here with its head up, antlers going most of the way to the ceiling, flanks steaming faintly as though it has come a long way at speed.
emotes: {it} lowers its head and lifts it again, antlers scraping a line down the ceiling.
{it} stamps once. The sound arrives a moment late.
{it} turns an ear towards the door and holds it there.
looks: The antlers are in velvet, and the velvet is torn on one side and hanging.
It is steaming. The room is not cold enough for anything to steam.
It has planted all four feet and is not going to be moved by anything you have on you.
name: a stag standing in the middle of the room
says: I came a long way to stand here.
